text: dsh-lark-claw（DSH 插件，适用于配置了 Lark 或飞书渠道的 DSH 客户端）：把聊天机器人接入 DSH，让用户在私聊或群聊中提交任务并在同一话题继续交流。它通过持久化网关把飞书消息映射到 DSH Session，展示实时执行卡片，并处理图片、文件、审批和问题回答。还可让 Agent 创建、查看和删除持久化定时任务，支持一次性时间、延迟、固定间隔和 cron 表达式。适合希望从飞书或 Lark 对话中使用 DSH、接收进度或安排提醒的团队。需要配置 Lark/飞书应用、可用的 DSH 模型及工作目录。

dsh-lark-claw connects DSH sessions to Lark or Feishu chats. It shows live progress, handles attachments and interactive approvals, and supports recurring or one-time tasks. A configured chat app, model, and workspace are needed.
想在飞书或 Lark 里直接给 DSH 发任务，并在同一话题接着聊。
希望群聊机器人把我的消息交给 DSH 处理，并显示执行进度。
我想让 DSH 定时提醒我，或按固定周期自动执行任务。
能不能在飞书里查看、修改或删除已经安排的定时任务？
I want to send DSH tasks from a Feishu or Lark chat and keep the conversation in its thread.
Can DSH run reminders on a schedule and deliver them back to my chat?
I need live progress cards and a way to answer approval prompts from Feishu.
dsh-lark-claw 的功能「对话式任务」：收到的 Lark/飞书消息会进入对应 DSH 会话，并将执行进度更新到卡片；用户可在同一话题继续交流。
dsh-lark-claw 的功能「图片与文件消息」：网关读取消息中的图片和文件作为会话输入，并可把会话生成的附件回复到话题中。
dsh-lark-claw 的功能「交互式审批与提问」：需要审批或补充回答时，网关发送带按钮或表单的卡片；发起任务的用户可在卡片中提交或拒绝。
dsh-lark-claw 的功能「持久化定时任务」：Agent 可创建一次性或重复任务，按时在飞书渠道运行指令；任务可列出和删除，并写入持久化存储。
dsh-lark-claw 使用前须知：需配置 Lark/飞书应用凭据和可用模型；定时 API 可设 bearer token。（见 src/gateway/index.ts:435-443；src/cron/index.ts:30-43）
我想通过飞书让 DSH 帮我处理项目里的工作，并看到过程。
I want scheduled DSH tasks to send their results to a Feishu conversation.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Use DeepSeek Harness from Lark or Feishu and let your bot handle tasks.**

Message the bot directly or mention it in a group to explore a project, analyze a file, or schedule a reminder. Follow progress in a live card and continue the conversation in the same topic.

dsh-lark-claw README · dsh-lark-claw：- **Ongoing conversations**: Keep context per topic and continue after a service restart.
- **Live progress**: See responses and tool activity directly in chat.
- **Images and files**: Ask about a screenshot or reply to a file message to process it.
- **Scheduled tasks**: Set one-time reminders or recurring tasks in natural language.

dsh-lark-claw README · Quickstart：You need dsh `0.1.2-rc.1` or later, Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`, pnpm, and a Lark/Feishu app. Make sure your model and API key already work in dsh.

Configure the app in the Lark/Feishu developer console:

dsh-lark-claw README · Quickstart：- Enable the bot capability.
- Select long-connection event delivery and subscribe to `im.message.receive_v1`.
- Grant the app-identity permissions needed to receive, send, read, and download message resources. Responding to group messages without a bot mention also requires `im:message.group_msg`.
- Publish the app or add test users to its availability scope. Add the bot to each group where it will be used.

**Install the plugin:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile feishu add dsh-lark-claw
```

dsh-lark-claw README · Quickstart：Without an explicit version, this installs the npm `latest` release. To upgrade an existing installation, run the command below and then restart the running `dsh --profile feishu` process:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile feishu update dsh-lark-claw@latest
```

`dsh plugin` uses pnpm to manage the profile. If the required version is not yet on npm, follow the [local source installation](guides/advanced.md#install-from-local-source) instructions.

**Configure your bot:**

dsh-lark-claw README · Quickstart：Use the [example configuration](config.yaml.example) to fill in `~/.dsh/config.yaml` (or the directory set by `DSH_HOME`). Merge the required fields if you already have a configuration.

dsh-lark-claw README · Quickstart：- Enter your app's App ID and App Secret.
- Set the users and groups allowed to use the bot. `ou_xxx` is a user open_id and `oc_xxx` is a chat_id. The example enables a direct-message allowlist, so leaving its placeholder rejects every direct message.
- Choose an absolute workspace path for the bot's files and configure an available model.

See the [configuration guide](guides/advanced.md#configure) for field descriptions.

**Start:**

```sh
dsh --profile feishu
```
dsh-lark-claw README · Quickstart：Keep the process running. Send the bot a direct message or mention it in an allowed group; once it replies, you're ready.

dsh-lark-claw README · Work on a task：> @bot Look through this project and explain how to run it.

The bot shows progress in a card. Reply in the same topic to continue working on the task. Group messages require a bot mention by default.

dsh-lark-claw README · Ask about images and files：Send an image with your question. Image understanding requires a model that accepts image input.

If a file must be sent separately, send it first, then use Lark/Feishu's reply action on that file message and mention the bot:

> @bot Summarize this file and highlight what needs my attention.

File format support depends on the Agent's available tools.

dsh-lark-claw README · Schedule a reminder：> @bot Remind me to check project progress at 9 a.m. every weekday.

You can also ask it to list or delete reminders. Scheduled tasks are saved, but the service must be running when they are due.

dsh-lark-claw README · Approvals and questions：When an operation needs permission, the bot posts an Allow once / Reject card in the same topic. Questions appear as choices or text fields; submitting an answer continues the task. Only the user who started the current task can respond. Requests expire after ten minutes by default.

Enable card interaction callbacks in your Feishu app first; see [interaction setup](guides/advanced.md#approvals-and-user-questions).

dsh-lark-claw README · Commands：| Command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `/help` | Show help |
| `/status` | Check the current conversation's status |
| `/stop` | Stop the current task |
| `/reset` | Start a new conversation in the current topic |
